I traced Home → Join/preparation → Apply → recovery/review/submission → applicant next actions in current source. Changed fields, exact per-field choices, unchanged-field disclosure and a candid private download make long conflicting answers manageable; the supplied mobile capture shows readable text and reachable actions. However, schedule-fit facts remain absent, approved consulting artifacts are unavailable, and the complete authenticated application/status and consequential operator journeys lack hosted acceptance. These material unknowns prevent an unqualified world-class answer or release acceptance; I found no new recovery defect to invent.
